repositories.name: MicroDuck TinyVLA
repositories.description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: TinyVLA controls a live MicroDuck MuJoCo simulation from a 256×256 robot head-camera frame, the exact 61-dimensional policy state, and a language instruction. Physics and rendering run in the browser; model inference runs on the Space CPU.

The backend is fully ONNX Runtime CPU inference. The checkpoint is split into vision.onnx, a cacheable semantic.onnx, and an action.onnx containing all 10 flow-matching denoise steps. The CPU bundle dynamically quantizes vision and semantic weights to INT8; the sensitive flow sampler remains FP32. PyTorch, Transformers and LeRobot are not installed in the Space image.
The client follows the Stage 2.5 serving contract exactly:
features: simulate controls at 50 Hz;
capture a fresh head-camera observation every five controls (10 Hz);
request a 100×14 raw joint-offset chunk;
execute only its first five rows;
apply each row as DEFAULTPOSE + offset, then replan.
